scope: LP confirmed measurements, pressure approximations and two separate LP steam merges
test_command: python -m pytest tests/test_hrsg_lp.py tests/test_hrsg_ip.py tests/test_hrsg_hp.py tests/test_hp_parameter_audit.py tests/test_data_io.py tests/test_model_layers.py tests/test_stream_builder.py tests/test_gt_systems.py tests/test_system_stream_definitions.py -q -k 'not cooling'
coverage: Both boilers and exact user-selected return/mixed-state point import locations
Closed unknown recovery circulation does not block measured mixed P/T or drum feed flow
Economizer and valve-outlet pressure rules overwrite stale derived values
Upstream feed states are not silently assigned downstream mixed-state readings
Missing, negative or above-main steam split flow prevents forced downstream allocation
Unequal boiler branch flows sum only within their respective turbine or heating destination
Separate turbine/heating junction mass balances and input immutability
limitations: Complete ST/heating/plant registry construction still references user-deleted cooling; scoped LP builds and the two steam junctions were tested without restoring cooling
Other existing heating devices, including network-water boundaries, have not been rebuilt in this LP scope
Historical-window coverage is incomplete; synthetic behavior tests do not demonstrate an actual plant energy or exergy balance
